Working at eccenca

Shape The Future of Cutting Edge Technology

eccenca develops knowledge graph based solutions for an agile data exploitation and company-wide data transparency. We are committed to our corporate clients like Siemens, AstraZeneca, Ericsson, among others. We work fast and implement solutions creatively and professionally. Sometimes that means nothing less than rethinking everything. We meet this challenge every day.

At eccenca we are aware of both Directives of Employment Equality Framework and Racial Equality. Therefore, all qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, age, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

As part of our commitment to society, our people and the environment, eccenca is part of some important ESG (environment, social and governance) initiatives and reporting plattforms. We assess and report on our ESG performance through EcoVadis and CDP and set emission reduction targets with SBTi. Find out more. 

For me, working at eccenca with an inspiring team of young professionals who are passionate about networked data is just fascinating. I like the mixture of dynamic daily business and the relaxed atmosphere that results from that.

Nieves Sande, Research Project Manager

Run Your Own Projects

At eccenca you will work in a dedicated, diverse team from all over Europe. Together we are shaping the future of digital supply chains, data automation, compliance and complexity management. We think linked data.

In addition to the very good working conditions, I really appreciate the straightforward communication at eccenca. I also have the opportunity to develop myself in the field of high-end technologies – and of course enjoy life in the wonderful city of Leipzig.

Jorge Martinez Pizarro, Frontend Developer

Work In Berlin, Leipzig & Remote

As a dynamically growing, innovative company, we embrace an agile working philosophy. This also means, you decide where you want to work from – Leipzig, Berlin, Stuttgart or remote. We welcome creative talents from all stages in life – from starters to professionals.

At eccenca we continue to advance for our customers every day. This willingness to be agile and the associated flat hierarchy and hands-on mentality inspire me again and again.

Ivan Ermilov, Deployment Engineer

Think Linked

  • Agile team work & flat hierarchies
  • Free choice of location
  • Flexible work time models
  • Professional challenges
  • Personal development

(Junior) Sales Manager, Inside Sales (f/m/d) in Stuttgart

Join The Sales Department of eccenca GmbH

At eccenca we are convinced that access to knowledge combined and accessible with the right data on-time is at the heart of any company's future business success. We are a leading provider of Enterprise Knowledge Graph technology, helping companies connect data, processes, and rules in an intelligent way. With our software, we enable global organizations to make their data transparent, linked, and automated – providing the foundation for digital transformation, AI, and agile business processes.

We are growing – and so is our Sales team. To strengthen our Inside Sales capacity, we are looking for a motivated (Junior) Sales Manager (Inside Sales) for our office in Stuttgart, who supports eccenca in the acquisition of new customers, ensuring a scalable and efficient sales pipeline, and generating qualified leads.

In this role, you will be responsible for proactively engaging potential customers, qualifying leads, and closely supporting our Sales colleagues.

The Role

As a (Junior) Sales Manager (Inside Sales), you will:

  • Qualify inbound leads based on defined criteria.
  • Reach out proactively to potential customers via calls, emails, and LinkedIn/social selling.
  • Schedule meetings and demos for our Account Executives.
  • Keep our CRM data up to date and ensure activity tracking.
  • Collaborate with Marketing on lead generation campaigns.
  • Support the Sales team with offers, contracts, and follow-ups.
  • Contribute to CRM optimisation, sales materials, and process improvement projects.
  • You will also participate in trade fairs or online events, as well as internal process improvement projects.

What We Expect From You

  • First practical exposure to sales, customer contact, or business development (through jobs, internships, student jobs, or similar). Ideally, there would be 1–2 years of experience in Inside Sales or Customer Service.
  • Completed apprenticeship and practical experience or Bachelor’s degree. With the right motivation, career changers are welcome here.
  • Confident use of MS Office (Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).
  • Motivation, eagerness to learn, and a results-oriented mindset.
  • Strong communication skills, a professional phone manner, and excellent German and English.
  • Ideally, experience with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot).
  • Knowledge of B2B Tech markets is a big plus.

What We Offer You

  • A permanent, full-time work contract with a competitive salary package and 30 days of vacation per year.
  • An additional company health insurance and a company D-Ticket option.
  • The chance to contribute to a leading cutting-edge technology brand in an emerging international market that will change the face of how we work with data.
  • Flexibility regarding working hours and home office options.
  • Flat hierarchies and a friendly, team-oriented work environment in an international, multidisciplinary team.
  • A Startup spirit while working with some of the most innovative clients and partners in the world.
  • The chance to start your career in Sales and grow with us in the B2B Tech world.

Let’s Set Things In Motion!

Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer (f/m/d) — Leipzig (preferred) or Remote

Join Our Infrastructure Team

At eccenca, we develop eccenca Corporate Memory — a multidisciplinary Knowledge Graph platform that unifies rules, constraints, capabilities, configurations, and data within a single integrated environment. By going beyond traditional, application-centric metadata management, our semantic knowledge graph technology enables organizations to build systems that are highly extensible, interoperable, and transparent for both machines and business users. As part of our infrastructure team, you’ll help shape the cloud foundation that powers scalable, reliable, and secure data and AI-driven applications. Curious about the technology behind the platform? Explore our technical documentation to learn more.

YOUR PROFILE

  • 3+ years of experience in a DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, or Platform Engineering role
  • Hands-on experience operating and maintaining production environments using Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform and Ansible
  • Practical experience with containers and container orchestration technologies, especially Kubernetes and Docker Compose
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a pragmatic mindset
  • Solid experience working in UNIX/Linux environments
  • Passion for automation, reliability, and continuous improvement

YOUR ROLE

  • Drive cloud knowledge sharing and promote infrastructure best practices across the company
  • Help design, build, and operate our cloud-native applications and platforms
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows using GitLab
  • Provision and manage infrastructure on AWS and Azure
  • Install, configure, and optimize scalable and reusable infrastructure components
  • Translate technical requirements into reliable operational solutions
  • Contribute to testing, deployment, monitoring, and operational excellence
  • Continuously improve our DevOps tooling, processes, and delivery practices
  • Integrate security best practices into all aspects of infrastructure and operations
  • Stay current with emerging DevOps technologies, tools, and industry trends

What You’ll Work With

  • Kubernetes
  • Terraform
  • Ansible
  • GitLab CI/CD
  • AWS & Azure
  • Docker / Docker Compose

  • Linux / UNIX systems

About eccenca

eccenca GmbH (https://www.eccenca.com/) is developing next-generation data management tools and is headquartered in Leipzig, Germany.
